content: The demo candidate is an early-career machine learning engineer interested in reliable applied AI systems.
The demo candidate completed graduate-level training in data science, statistics and software engineering.
The demo candidate evaluated a machine learning matching system using ROC-AUC, threshold analysis and structured error reviews.
The demo candidate contributed to data cleaning, exploratory analysis and statistical modeling on operational datasets.
The demo candidate built an agentic workflow with LangGraph, structured LLM outputs and human-supervised tool calls.
The demo candidate developed a retrieval prototype using sentence embeddings, FAISS and explicit relevance evaluation.
The demo candidate created a FastAPI model-serving service and containerized it with Docker.
The demo candidate works with Python, SQL, PyTorch, scikit-learn, FastAPI, Git and Docker.
The demo candidate has practical experience with NLP, LLM APIs, RAG, evaluation metrics and data pipelines.
The demo candidate prefers concise application emails that only use evidence present in the candidate profile.
